Client SBS model third-party notice

This non-root Artemis APK contains converted and optimized TFLite depth models in:

  client-sbs-dav2-models.tar.xz
  client-sbs-midas-models.tar.xz
  client-sbs-depthart-models.tar.xz
  client-sbs-zipdepth-models.tar.xz

Depth Anything V2 Small
-----------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2
Upstream model card: https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small
The upstream project designates the Small model as Apache-2.0. A verbatim copy
of that license is bundled beside this notice as LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt.

Artemis ships modified TFLite conversions, not verbatim upstream checkpoint
files. The shipped graphs use fixed rectangular input/output contracts,
guarded attention and GELU graph rewrites, and FP16 storage for selected
weights. The source distribution records hashes for the immediate Float32
TFLite inputs and final packaged entries. It does not currently record a
pinned upstream checkpoint revision and digest, exporter revision, dependency
lock, or exact original export command, so it does not claim a complete
upstream-checkpoint-to-TFLite reproduction chain.

MiDaS v2.1 Small
----------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/isl-org/MiDaS
The shipped conversions derive from the pinned Qualcomm AI Hub MiDaS-V2
Float32 graph whose release, download revision, and hashes are recorded in the
Artemis source distribution. MiDaS is licensed under the MIT License. A
verbatim copy, including its copyright notice, is bundled beside this notice
as LICENSE-MIDAS-MIT.txt.

Artemis modifies that graph with fixed rectangular input/output and decoder
resize contracts and FP16 storage for selected weights. The source model card
also attributes its EfficientNet-Lite3 encoder under Apache-2.0; the bundled
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt supplies that license text as well.

DepthART S448 relative depth
----------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/xuefeng-cvr/DepthART
Upstream model repository: https://huggingface.co/Fengxue93/DepthART
The model repository metadata designates the released checkpoints as
Apache-2.0. A verbatim copy of that license is bundled beside this notice as
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt.

Artemis ships modified TFLite conversions of the official relative-depth S448
checkpoint, SHA-256
e17adf70a87b4d2b7665bf0546aad68f8c5b8b63866cbca604602a7859fadebe.
The conversion replaces the five SelectiveScan operators with exact associative
prefix scans, bakes ImageNet input normalization into fixed rectangular graphs,
stores selected weights as FP16, and retains Float32 public tensors. It does not
prune, retrain, approximate the scan recurrence, or substitute the S224 weights.
For Adreno FP16 execution, the first scan block's LayerNorm is algebraically
rescaled by four, with its epsilon rescaled by sixteen, so those intermediates
remain normal binary16 values. The other four LayerNorm blocks are unchanged.

ZipDepth original base relative depth
-------------------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth
Pinned source commit: 91f3fd21e131641f51e8d35736d1958350180e3a
The upstream repository's source code is distributed under the MIT License. A
verbatim copy, including its copyright notice, is bundled beside this notice as
LICENSE-ZIPDEPTH-MIT.txt.

Artemis ships modified TFLite conversions of the original zipdepth_base.pth
checkpoint, SHA-256
a55910bb0b99c8c5e641cb9206e810b269690ad94e8a2ef08c827c4679391a65.
These are the standard convex-unfold-tail base model, not the separately trained
base_npu checkpoint. The static graphs retain the learned convex upsampling,
replace one unsupported grouped convolution with an exactly equivalent dense
convolution, store selected weights as FP16, and retain Float32 public tensors.
The learned global-context weighted sum is algebraically power-of-two scaled to
avoid FP16 subnormal flushing on Adreno GPUs without changing its CPU result.

Upstream documents the checkpoint as knowledge-distilled from Depth Anything V2
Large. The upstream repository does not provide a separate model-weight license
or an analysis of that training relationship; review and clear the complete
checkpoint redistribution chain before any commercial release.

LiteRT 2.2.0 native runtime and accelerator
-------------------------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT
Upstream release: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/releases/tag/v2.2.0
The non-root APK ships the official LiteRT 2.2.0 Android libLiteRt.so runtime
and libLiteRtClGlAccelerator.so OpenCL/OpenGL accelerator for its packaged ABI.
The source distribution records the official download URLs and SHA-256 values
for both supported ABIs. These binaries are redistributed under Apache-2.0;
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt is bundled beside this notice.
